abstract: Learning user preferences from long behavioral sequences is fundamental to large-scale advertising, recommender systems, and conversational agents. In industrial systems, preference modeling is typically task-wise, with different downstream tasks independently processing the same user history to capture different aspects of preference. This repeated processing creates substantial redundancy at billion-user scale, especially as preferences evolve and representations require frequent updates. We present KuaFu, a unified user preference modeling system that replaces repeated user-level sequence encoding with reusable item-level compressed representations. Each behavioral item is encoded once and shared across users and downstream tasks, while a user's history is built chronologically and extended with new item representations as they arrive, letting KuaFu capture evolving preferences without re-encoding the entire history. To reduce inference and storage overhead, KuaFu introduces a two-axis projector: token-axis compression shortens behavior sequences by up to 15x and reduces each item from 150 KB to 10 KB, while width-axis compression reduces the cached representation to 0.5 KB. We further develop a four-stage training pipeline consisting of reconstruction pre-training, preference-understanding post-training, joint compression-generation training, and hallucination-aware reinforcement learning, progressively improving representation fidelity and downstream utility. Across six MRQA and five RecBench benchmarks, KuaFu consistently outperforms existing compression methods at comparable ratios, with gains of up to 17.7 EM and 1.90 AUC points respectively. KuaFu has been deployed and evaluated on the Tencent advertising and recommendation platform for ten months. Over this period, it improves per-GPU throughput by up to 350%, saves 190 GPUs, and increases overall GMV by 1.37%.
key_ideas:
🔸 条目级编码与缓存：压缩器（LoRA 适配的因果语言模型）将每个条目的文本编码为若干 memory token，表示只依赖条目本身，可离线缓存并在用户与任务间复用，用户历史按时序检索拼装。
🔸 双轴投影器：token 轴把 8 个 memory 向量压缩到 2 个，宽度轴从 2560 维降到 128 维，生产中每条目缓存从约 40KB 降至 0.5KB；早期训练用余弦退火的池化残差稳定优化，收敛后移除。
🔸 四阶段训练：重建预训练（分桶 1→1200 条目的课程）、压缩问答后训练、三模块联合训练、以及基于 DAPO 的幻觉感知强化学习，奖励惩罚四类错误并加完整性奖励防止以拒绝回答规避错误。
🔸 分层评估协议：从分类、多标签偏好归因到问答与多任务迁移逐级评估压缩表示质量，缩短压缩质量与下游性能之间的反馈回路。
🔸 生产部署采用条目侧日更与用户侧周更双异步流水线，离线表示库随条目库存而非用户数增长。
analysis_summary:
🔸 离线效果：内部基准上 KuaFu 总分 63.0，较最佳软压缩基线高 20.6 分；MRQA 15× 压缩下达 50.8 EM，超过 5× 下的 SAC（46.95）；RecBench 零样本 AUC 0.617，比同骨干 Qwen3-4B 高 4.70 点，但 CDs 子集出现回退（0.489 vs 0.510）。
🔸 幻觉控制：RL 使编造率从 33.5% 降至 4.5%，全对率从 56.0% 升至 90.0%，完整性基本不变（91.5%），且人类标注与两个 LLM 评审方向一致（κ=0.72–0.91）。
🔸 检索保真度：needle-in-a-haystack 探针显示四阶段训练将 F1 从 8–22 提升至 78–96，1200+ 条目序列仍有 78 F1，随长度增长优雅退化。
🔸 消融：课程分桶使损失从 2.27 降至 0.02–0.28（总 token 量几乎相同），阶段间权重继承将验证损失从 4.1 降到 0.8，投影器与解码器各设计均有贡献。
🔸 生产收益：per-GPU 吞吐最高提升 350%，节省 190 块 GPU，在线 A/B（1%→100% 放量后保留 5% 对照十个月）显示整体 GMV 提升 1.37%（95% CI [0.71%, 2.03%]）。
personal_view: 基于全文分析，KuaFu 的核心创新在于把上下文压缩的粒度从“每用户每任务”下移到“每条目”，使压缩结果天然可缓存、可复用，这一条目中心的抽象是其在十亿级规模上实现吞吐与 GMV 双收益的关键，也是区别于 ICAE、SAC 等序列级压缩工作的根本点。四阶段训练与幻觉感知 RL 针对压缩引入的具体失败模式设计奖励，工程针对性强，且有 20 亿条目库存、在线 A/B 等生产验证，实用价值扎实。局限方面：固定压缩比可能不适合稀疏或异质行为（作者也承认）；零样本 RecBench 上 CDs 子集出现回退，说明条目独立编码可能丢失跨条目协同信号；此外内部基准由作者自建并以 LLM 评审打分，尽管做了评审稳健性检验，外部可比性仍有限，且核心数据为私有日志，复现依赖公开基准部分。
